title: Agent event, v0 (experimental)
description: One thing a coding agent did, as written by Ascenda's collectors to the local event log. Metadata only: no prompt text, file contents, file names, command lines or command output. Experimental; see the package README for the compatibility policy.

id.description: Unique per event. The same id twice means the same event.

utcOffsetMinutes.description: Minutes the machine's clock was ahead of UTC at `time`.

agent.description: Which agent. Known values: claude_code, codex, cursor, gemini_cli, windsurf, vscode. Other agents send their own name.

kind.description: What happened. Read a kind you don't know as `other`: v0 may add kinds.

sessionId.description: The agent's own session id, when it gives one.

subagentId.description: Set on events inside a subagent, and on its start and stop.

tool.description: The tool's name as the agent reports it, on tool.* kinds.

outcome.description: How a tool call ended, when known: success, failure or cancelled.

durationBucket.description: How long it took, as a bucket: 0-1m, 1-5m, 5-10m, 10-30m, 30-60m, 60m+. Never an exact duration.

projectHash.description: Salted hash of the project. The salt stays on the machine.

repoKey.description: The repository: a 32-bit digest of the lowercased owner/repo of a github.com remote. The same value a code-forge collector sends on pull request events. Not salted, so anyone who guesses the name can recompute it.

branchKey.description: The branch: a 64-bit digest of the lowercased owner/repo, a newline and the branch name. Set per event. Not salted. Absent on the default branch.

headRepoKey.description: On a pull request event from a fork: the key of the fork that holds the head branch. Match a session's repoKey against this when it is set, and against repoKey when it isn't.

prCreatedAt.description: On pull_request.* events: when GitHub says the pull request was created.

prClosedAt.description: On pull_request.closed and pull_request.merged: when it was closed.

prMergedAt.description: On pull_request.merged: when it was merged.

promptId.description: The agent's own opaque id for the prompt a turn answers, where it gives one.

vcsAction.description: On tool.completed, when it was a version-control step: commit, push, pr_created or pr_merged. Read a value you don't know as absent.

reason.description: On agent.waiting, why the agent stopped: permission, idle or other. Read a value you don't know as other.

model.description: On session.started: the model slug the agent reported.

sourceType.description: The collector's own name for the event, for debugging. Not part of the contract.
